scenes.role: establish the children’s ordinary goals and borrow
prerequisites: The children arrive before the exhibit opens.
actions: Enter the room, ask to borrow the torch, check its switch.
consequences: The torch is in the children’s custody and has been checked.
prose_obligations: Mara wants a striking exhibit; Tavi wants an explanation.
scenes.consolidation: Arrival, request, handoff, and switch check are one executable local play.

prerequisites: The attendant agrees to lend the museum torch.
actions: Receive and test the torch.
consequences: The children can make a shadow; the museum still owns the torch.
prose_obligations: Make the loan explicit and make return matter.
scenes.consolidation: Combined with meeting the attendant and entering the room.

prerequisites: Torch borrowed.
actions: Switch on against the bare wall, then switch off.
consequences: Torch is checked; no shadow result is invented.
prose_obligations: Do not imply a faulty torch before it has been tested.
scenes.consolidation: A small action within the loan scene, not a standalone encounter.

prerequisites: Torch checked; figure starts at the screen-side peg.
actions: Cast the first shadow without changing the setup.
consequences: A recorded small or unreadable first observation persists.
prose_obligations: The poster promises more than this attempt shows.
scenes.consolidation: The recorded observation and puzzled reaction form one executable scene.

prerequisites: First demonstration has happened.
actions: Compare the outline with the poster’s giant silhouette.
consequences: The children decide to test rather than alter everything.
prose_obligations: Preserve the difference between a result and an explanation.
scenes.consolidation: Narrated inside the first-shadow encounter; no extra state effect.

prerequisites: The first demonstration is recorded.
actions: Read which peg supposedly makes a giant shadow.
consequences: Both children know the printed target peg.
prose_obligations: State the instruction clearly without declaring it true.
scenes.consolidation: Reading and comparing the printed peg with the starting position are one scene.

scenes.role: turn the label into a testable claim
prerequisites: Label read; figure remains at screen-side peg.
actions: Notice whether the figure began on the printed target.
consequences: They have a specific distance question.
prose_obligations: Do not silently change the figure position.
scenes.consolidation: Part of reading the label; the initial position was already physically established.

prerequisites: First shadow and label have been seen; investigation has not begun.
actions: Notice June watching from the next table.
consequences: Visitor presence is recorded only if this scene is selected.
prose_obligations: Give the children an ordinary reason to explain the shadow to someone else.
scenes.consolidation: Arrival and the reassuring exchange are combined.

prerequisites: June is present in the selected vignette.
actions: Show that the apparent ghost is a paper figure and light.
consequences: June is reassured and can respond in the ending.
prose_obligations: Do not claim she attended if her vignette was omitted.
scenes.consolidation: Shares one executable ID with June’s arrival; omission has no callback.

prerequisites: First observation recorded; investigation has not begun.
actions: Sketch the first outline without improving it.
consequences: A durable drawing of the actual first observation is saved.
prose_obligations: Tavi values an honest record over an attractive one.
scenes.consolidation: The sketch and disagreement over beautifying it are one scene.

prerequisites: First trial completed.
actions: Switch the torch off before moving the figure.
consequences: Children do not move a figure through an active beam.
prose_obligations: Show the change in a readable, ordinary way.
scenes.consolidation: Combined with shade and figure repositioning.

prerequisites: The room begins bright; first trial is complete.
actions: Draw the available window shade.
consequences: Ambient light is reduced for the second observation.
prose_obligations: If the room is already dim, do not narrate a shade action.
scenes.consolidation: Conditional local action in the setup scene; omitted when unnecessary.

prerequisites: Torch off; first trial at screen-side peg.
actions: Move the paper figure to the lamp-side peg.
consequences: Figure distance and later magnification change together.
prose_obligations: Keep the same screen, figure, and torch.
scenes.consolidation: Combined with the controlled-comparison setup.

prerequisites: Figure has moved to lamp-side peg.
actions: Agree to compare distances rather than changing several things.
consequences: A persistent hypothesis records the next question.
prose_obligations: Use childlike dialogue, not a lecture.
scenes.consolidation: The hypothesis is set during the same setup scene.

prerequisites: Figure at lamp-side peg; setup controlled.
actions: Switch on the same torch and record the second outline.
consequences: Second observation records size and visibility.
prose_obligations: Contrast the readings only when both are readable.
scenes.consolidation: Observation and comparison are a single short local play.

prerequisites: Both readings recorded.
actions: Compare magnification and readability.
consequences: Evidence is either near-torch-larger or inconclusive.
prose_obligations: Weak evidence must not become certainty.
scenes.consolidation: The inference is made in the retest scene; no unselected action runs.

scenes.role: successful ending with a sound label
prerequisites: Readable comparison; printed target is lamp-side.
actions: Leave a tested display at the printed peg; return torch.
consequences: Next visitors inherit a usable demonstration and returned torch.
prose_obligations: Reward the work with a completed exhibit, not a vague plan.
scenes.consolidation: One of three mutually exclusive ending encounters.

prerequisites: Readable evidence; printed target is screen-side.
actions: Correct the peg instruction, leave the demonstration ready, return torch.
consequences: The exhibit is fixed and the borrowed torch is useful to the museum again.
prose_obligations: Credit the children’s fair comparison.
scenes.consolidation: One of three mutually exclusive ending encounters.

prerequisites: At least one reading is too faint to compare.
actions: Post an honest limitation note and return torch for recharge.
consequences: A misleading claim is avoided; the museum receives useful information.
prose_obligations: Let disappointment resolve into an honest, complete choice.
scenes.consolidation: One of three mutually exclusive ending encounters.

scenes.role: resolve the loan and pass on the result
prerequisites: One compatible ending is enacted.
actions: Switch off, return the torch, tell Mr. Bell what was learned.
consequences: Custody returns to the museum; the torch’s comparison use is recorded.
prose_obligations: The object is useful again, not merely back in the right hands.
scenes.consolidation: Return is inside each ending so no ending can leave the loan unfinished.
